sizing: His share counts scaled so each trade starts at $1,000; $1,000 when he gave none

rules.text: Skip trades where risk to reward is unfavorable; potential loss should not exceed potential profit.
rules.quote: your risk to reward just isn't there

rules.text: Don't carry an open position that only consolidates; close it at support
rules.quote: I would rather not carry an open position

rules.text: Never be afraid to take profits.
rules.quote: remember never be afraid to take profits

rules.text: Use the 5-minute chart to avoid impulsive trades off the 1-minute chart.
rules.quote: make impulsive trades off of that one minute time frame

rules.text: Don't fight a strong trend; let it run instead of shorting against it.
rules.quote: no reason to fight that Trend let it rip up

rules.text: Don't hold a short overnight into earnings; trade extended hours instead.
rules.quote: no I'm not going to be holding one overnight

rules.text: Mark support as the consolidation zone, not the exact lowest point
rules.quote: I don't like to look at the specific lowest point

rules.text: Never use indicators like MACD or RSI as the sole reason to enter.
rules.quote: those are just indicators. Never sole reason.

rules.text: Only enter a short after a continuous descending pattern, not after a quick oversold bounce.
rules.quote: I want to see continuous descending pattern.

rules.text: Cash out when a trade stops progressing and shows support, even if profitable.
rules.quote: when in doubt never be afraid to cash out.

rules.text: If entering before confirmation, use at most 10% of desired position size.
rules.quote: I could only enter with 10% or less of my position size

rules.text: At overbought levels hold lighter positions and more cash; redeploy cash into oversold, good-value names.
rules.quote: At overbought levels, I'm a little bit lighter on the positions
